messages:
Sam: Heads-up — saw a cluster of short-lived reconnects from eu-west after the keepalive tweak at 03:12 UTC. Lots of 100-200ms connect spikes, then immediate close. No obvious 5xx.
Priya: ugh. is this the new proxy keepalive window we rolled this morning? @deploy-bot what did we change exactly?
deploy-bot: Deployed keepalive change "timeout=30s" to proxy pool eu-west-1 at 03:09 UTC. Rollout: 100%.
Mateo: telemetry shows client-driven closes. sockets show TCP FIN from clients, but proxy logs show RESET within 50ms. Could be half-close handling mismatch.
Linh: Do we have a way to attribute these to the console vs SDK clients? ops-monitor, any traces linking to auth tokens or routes?
ops-monitor: Found ~460 reconnects from 2k sessions in the window. 78% include header `X-Client-SDK: js/1.4.2`. ~30% have `X-Route-Tag: realtime-preview`. No auth failures.
Jen: if client sent FIN then proxy shouldn't reply with RST, that causes immediate reconnect loops. Maybe our env change tightened backlog or closed lingering sockets.
Sam: Repro locally: `curl --http1.1 -H "Connection: keep-alive" -H "X-Client-SDK: js/1.4.2" <sse-endpoint>` then send FIN from client side results in proxy sending RST when under load. Suspect libuv/nginx keepalive handling.
Mateo: Two things to fix in short term: 1) Add a `reconnect_reason` telemetry label (client_fin | server_rst | idle_timeout) so metrics can be grouped. 2) Console filter to collapse transient reconnects < 5s into single session view to avoid alert noise.
Priya: Agree. Also quota accounting: some sessions were charged as new sessions for each reconnect. We need a dedupe window keyed by `session_id` header to avoid double-billing on short reconnects.
Linh: Suggest header proto: `X-Session-Id` propagated from the client. If present, the quota daemon should merge events within a 10s sliding window. Add metrics `session_reconnects` and `session_reconnect_reason`.
Sam: Example header we can standardize in SDKs:
```
X-Session-Id: 45a1c2d3-...\nX-Client-SDK: js/1.4.2\nX-Reconnect-Reason: client_fin
```
Mateo: I'll start a small deploy: add `reconnect_reason` label to logs + a new histogram for reconnect durations. Jen can you own the quota dedupe change? Priya can you add the console UI filter?
Jen: On it. Will add dedupe logic to quota service (10s window, extendable via config). Will add integration test for billing idempotency.
Priya: I'll prototype the console grouping in the sessions view — collapsible grouping and a toggle to show raw events. Will also make a per-route rollup to surface problematic routes like `realtime-preview`.
ops-monitor: created alert rule `reconnect-spike-eu-west` (threshold: >200 reconnects / 5m) and linked to this thread. No page unless >500.
Sam: Quick mitigation: rollback keepalive to previous value for eu-west and patch proxy to ignore stray FIN->RST sequence. Mateo, can you coordinate a canary rollback?
Mateo: Rolling back to `timeout=60s` on edge proxies for eu-west-1 now. Canary to 10% in 1m.
Jen: QA: once dedupe is live, run billing reconciliation job for affected window and file credits if double-counted.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene in 30m to check telemetry post-rollback and after dedupe patch merge. :thumbsup:
